Both reviewed formula identities; derived zero-weight requirements and nonempty all-zero rules; strict map/proper-list/numeric validation with no float/string coercion; full four-group/reference-union/nonempty mapping validation. Exact typed integer/Decimal canonical round-trip including equivalent Decimals, negative zero, large coefficients/extreme exponents and varied contexts; no arbitrary atom/module decode.

Complete saves for both strategies, distinct UUID per save, full rules and stable creation-time/UUID ordering, no activation or partial writes; unknown versus empty versus storage failure. Direct Repo/SQL attempts to modify/delete/truncate versions/history/anchor including unused rules/metadata fail; constraints reject reused IDs, orphan targets and disconnected selection changes and unsupported write isolation; atomic rollback retains original state.

Explicit first activation, switch/restore, expected-current conflict before no-op, matching no-op without history duplication; ordered previous/new/time records and saving without selection effects. Separate PostgreSQL backends with real commits, first-activation and competing different-target races, old/new reader visibility, equal-time ordering, and approved identity comparison after A-to-B-to-A.

Active/explicit inactive evaluation fixes one full saved version before facts; controlled in-flight activation cannot mix rules. UUID/formula/evidence binding; exact balanced 1 versus 2 and approved position-aware 2 versus 4; override validation before empty history. Distinct no-active/not-found/unsupported/empty/unknown-required-metric/unmapped-position failures; no fallback or writes.

Original UUID lookup and full canonical rules/formula/reference/requirements/mapping comparison before inherited authoritative membership replay. Rule switching, late facts, current affiliation changes and absent/unused settings cannot substitute evidence; unavailable/unsupported/altered raw/derived/score evidence fails without score. At least 20 rule/mapping permutations produce canonical equivalent rules/results with distinct saved identities.

Commit versions/selection/history in a guarded isolated test namespace; fresh BEAM application instances load solely from storage after terminating previous clients/runtime. Exact numeric canonical evidence survives restart under varied Decimal contexts, no implicit activation, stable list/history ties, explicit inactive evaluation and original-envelope replay after activation/late facts; child failures propagate as assertion failures.

Exact 33-path active-feature inventory and role-separated AST checks preserve pure engine/formula restrictions and legacy allowances. Provider/HTTP/event/job call tracing plus SQL assertions: reads/evaluate/replay do not mutate any table; create/activation write only own version/history. Real storage failures stay visible; no routes, presets, quote/financial code or unversioned production market path.

Complete audited integration profile including new persistence/activation/managed/replay/durability/architecture suites, inherited valuation regressions, and existing real Chromium/browser checks; service/browser unavailability fails.
